status: Design only; no publication prototype implemented
dependency: First require all16 shadow bitwise gate and actual early-token D2H profile.
candidate: Publish from the existing early-copy object, keep original late object/event for InputBatch and source lifetime. Reuse native deferred_frees with a separate GPU retirement watermark.
key_FIFO_proof: Both early-copy(k) and unchanged late-copy(k-1) use the identical runner async_output_copy_stream. Worker RPC sampling is ordered: late(k-1) is enqueued before early(k). Completion of early(k) therefore covers original native late(k-1), even if current MTP(k) remains in flight. All16 worker output aggregation is mandatory. This is a proposed dependency argument, not a validated implementation.
required_protocol: Assign explicit monotonically increasing GPU step sequence in SchedulerOutput, including zero-token KV-copy-only steps when present.

ModelRunnerOutput reports per-rank retired-through sequence: early publication covers previous late sequence; native fallback covers current. KVOutputAggregator validates exact16 outputs and uses minimum retirement watermark.

Scheduler.update_from_output must advance processed_step_seq from validated retirement watermark, not from early token response count. Preserve original request/CoW deferred-free fences and all connector completion logic.

Keep engine polling while issued GPU steps or deferred_frees remain after final request/abort. A no-forward drain waits original last late event on each rank before ACK; zero-token KV writes need their own equivalent copy-stream/default-stream retirement event.
Keep original late event/tensor in InputBatch, and retain late Async GPU source references until its own event is complete. Reject unsupported/logprobs/grammar/dtype/shape cases to native.

Check cancellation before early model output, queued subsequent batch, immediate cross-request KV reuse, CoW retained blocks, load failure, empty drain, all16 mixed readiness, and shutdown. Do not infer backend abort coverage from client closes or zero abort logs.
risks: Do not advance retirement merely because early sample data is ready for the current step.
Do not introduce first-rank ACK, discard source references early, or let zero-token/CoW drain quiesce with held blocks.
Keep fresh immutable build and frozen finite gates; no hot patches or parameter sweep.
performance: No gain forecast. Early data availability may improve visible token timing while unchanged compute limits throughput; only a subsequent service comparison can establish that.
